_comment: Abilities to remove from the base. Each id is dropped from
data/base/abilities.json and from every format whitelist in
data/formats/*.json. Any species that listed the ability in its
abilities field will silently lose it at render time (the data-loader
resolves species abilities against the per-format whitelist, so a
missing id just doesn't show up in the species's resolved list).
Edit the list below; re-run `npm run prep:abilities:patch` to apply.
